Entry.JapaneseText: ここは屈強の戦士が 集う闘技場

Entry.JapaneseText: ん？ 参加希望者か？

Entry.JapaneseText: 観覧席からでも見ていろ

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは屈強の戦士が 集う闘技場
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena, where the strongest warriors gather.

Entry.JapaneseText: 参加希望者か？
Entry.EnglishText: You want to participate?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……むむ、 小さいなりして、 その眼光……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hmm. You're quite small, but...that gleam in your eyes...

Entry.JapaneseText: よかろう、 参加を許可しよう
Entry.EnglishText: Very well. I'll permit you to enter.

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰が参加するのだ？
Entry.EnglishText: Who's entering?

Entry.JapaneseText: なに、そう 複雑なルールでもない
Entry.EnglishText: Really, there aren't an awful lot of rules.

Entry.JapaneseText: 奥から、次々と 敵が出てくる
Entry.EnglishText: Enemies will come from inside, one after another.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヤツら全員に 勝ち抜けば優勝だ
Entry.EnglishText: If you win against all of 'em, then you're the victor.

Entry.JapaneseText: 公平性を期すために、 アイテムは一旦、すべて こちらで預からせてもらう
Entry.EnglishText: In the interest of fairness, we'll keep your consumable items for the duration of the challenge.

Entry.JapaneseText: よって、アップルグミなどは こちらから支給するもの以外は 持てない
Entry.EnglishText: Furthermore, we'll supply you with our own Apple Gels and so on, which you can use freely.

Entry.JapaneseText: いいな？
Entry.EnglishText: Got it?

Entry.JapaneseText: ビギナーとエキスパート、 どちらの大会に参加する？
Entry.EnglishText: Do you want to compete at the Beginner or Expert level?

Entry.JapaneseText: ビギナーは初心者用、 エキスパートは上級者用だ
Entry.EnglishText: Beginner is for newbies, and Expert is for veterans.

Entry.JapaneseText: では、中へ
Entry.EnglishText: Very well. You may enter.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だ
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だ
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance.

Entry.JapaneseText: 参加したいのか？ それなら隣のヤツに 話してくれ
Entry.EnglishText: You want to enter? Just speak to the guy over there.

Entry.JapaneseText: 参加したいのか？ それなら隣のヤツに 話してくれ
Entry.EnglishText: You want to enter? Just speak to the guy over there.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一度、舞台の上に立つと、 引き下がれません
Entry.EnglishText: Once you've set foot in the Arena, you can't just withdraw.

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝ち抜くか、死ぬまで、 私たちは戦わねばならない、 それがこの闘技場なのです
Entry.EnglishText: You win it all, or you die. Either way, you have to keep fighting. That's what the Arena's all about.

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当、死ぬかと思いました。 救護班がいなければ、 私は命を落としてました
Entry.EnglishText: I really thought I would die. If not for the Arena's first aid team, I'd have lost my life here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 彼らは命の恩人…… はっ、まさかそうやって、 恩を売っているのでは……
Entry.EnglishText: They're true saviors... But wait, what if they start asking for something in return...?

Entry.JapaneseText: どうだい、おまえら、 もう闘技場では戦ったかい？
Entry.EnglishText: How are you guys doin'? Have you fought in the Arena yet?

Entry.JapaneseText: まだだったら、 行ってみるといいさ、 くっくっく……
Entry.EnglishText: If you haven't yet, you really should try it out. Heh heh...

Entry.JapaneseText: くっくっく…… おまえら強そうだな、 ガキのくせに
Entry.EnglishText: Heh heh... I know you're just kids, but you look pretty strong.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……めっためたにやられるのを 見てみたいぜ、くっくっく
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wanna see you get laid out nice and proper... Heh heh...

Entry.JapaneseText: ２回戦で負けた……
Entry.EnglishText: I lost in Round Two...

Entry.JapaneseText: ムリだ！ こんな大会！ 絶対優勝できないように できてるに違ぇねーぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: There's no way! This competition's too much! They've obviously set the whole thing up so no one will ever win!

Entry.JapaneseText: 次こそは！ 優勝！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Next time! I'll win it all!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……と言って、 もう何回、挑戦したことか……
Entry.EnglishText: ...or so I tell myself, but just how many times have I already tried...?

Entry.JapaneseText: あら、あんたたち、 強そうじゃない？ 大会には出た？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, don't you all look strong? Have you tried the Arena yet?

Entry.JapaneseText: まだだったら、 試してみるのは ありかもね、一度だけでも
Entry.EnglishText: If you haven't yet, why not give it a shot? Even just the once.

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしはこんな大会、出ないわよ。 だって、負けるのわかってるもの
Entry.EnglishText: I won't enter, though, myself. I already know I'd lose.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここだけの話…… 優勝できないように できてるのよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Don't tell anyone I told you, but... The whole thing's set up so no one can win...

Entry.JapaneseText: 父ちゃんは負けたけど 闘技大会は すごく興奮するんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: My dad lost, but the Arena's still super exciting!

Entry.JapaneseText: 見てたら、だんだん、 大会に出たくなってきたよ
Entry.EnglishText: And the more I watch, the more I want to try entering!

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしも大会に出たいなぁって 言ってたら、止められちった
Entry.EnglishText: But when I said I wanted to enter, too, my dad stopped me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 父ちゃんよりは やる自信あるけどなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm pretty sure I'd do better than he did, though...

Entry.JapaneseText: 娘が大会に出るとか 言い出して 困ってるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: My daughter said she wants to enter the Arena. It makes me worry.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何が困るって…… もし万が一、娘が勝ったら、 どうするってんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Why am I worried? Well, in the unlikely event she won, what would I do then?

Entry.JapaneseText: 娘が大会に出て、１回戦でも 突破できてみろ、オレの 父親としてのプライドズタボロだ
Entry.EnglishText: And even if she only got through Round One, she'd still be totally shredding my pride as a father...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレなんて１回戦も 突破できてないんだからな
Entry.EnglishText: Because I haven't been able to get through Round One, myself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の戦いは 残酷だますわね
Entry.EnglishText: Battles in the Arena are cruel.

Entry.JapaneseText: 血がだらだら、汗もだらだら 見ているだけで不快だます！
Entry.EnglishText: Drops and spatters of blood and sweat, everywhere! It's genuinely unpleasant!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……でも、なぜかワクワクしてる わたしもいるだます……
Entry.EnglishText: ...And yet, somehow, part of me always feels a little excited...

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしはこの国へ来て、 少し変わってしまっただます
Entry.EnglishText: I've changed a little since I came to this country.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだかおかしいだます 旅に出ると人は 変わってしまうだますかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: It's quite strange, really. I wonder if traveling always changes people...

Entry.JapaneseText: この５０年で闘技場に挑んだ者、 ２２万６千人
Entry.EnglishText: In these last fifty years, 226,000 people have challenged the Arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: うち優勝者はゼロ、死亡者は３４人 再起不能の重傷者１２２４人
Entry.EnglishText: Of those, there have been zero champions, 34 deaths, and 1,224 serious and permanent injuries.

Entry.JapaneseText: どこの記録にも残っとらんが、 ワシは覚えておるぞ
Entry.EnglishText: None of this is in any of the records, but I remember it all.

Entry.JapaneseText: この５０年で入った観覧客は ２億２５５１万６千人……
Entry.EnglishText: In these last fifty years, the Arena has held 225,516,000 total spectators.

Entry.JapaneseText: ワシもこんな数字覚えてて 何の役に立つんじゃろうな……？
Entry.EnglishText: But is there any use in me remembering all that?

Entry.JapaneseText: おっと、待ちな、 ここからはオレの花道！ てめぇは通してなるめぇよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you, wait right there. This is the path I walk alone! Don't you dare set foot on it!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、かかって来な！ 売られたケンカは 買ってやるぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, come at me! Whoever wants a fight, I'll take you all on!

Entry.JapaneseText: おっと待て…… 無益な争いは やめようぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, wait. Nothing good'll come of fighting out here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 文句があるなら、 闘技場の舞台の上で 闘おうじゃねぇか？
Entry.EnglishText: If you've got an issue with me, let's take it to the Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近、あなた、 私のエサ場、荒らしちゃって くれてない？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you been traipsing through my hunting grounds?

Entry.JapaneseText: エサ場はエサ場、 私の闘技場よ……ウフフ……
Entry.EnglishText: Hunting grounds, you know, hunting grounds. My personal Arena... Ahaha...

Entry.JapaneseText: エサ場を荒らす人は おしおきしちゃうわよ？
Entry.EnglishText: If you mess up my hunting grounds, I'll punish you, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: おしおきってのは おしおきよ…… 覚悟しなさいね、うふふ……
Entry.EnglishText: "Punish," you know? Punish. So you better prepare yourselves. Ahaha...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここから先は王との謁見を 許されたものだけが 入れる場所だ
Entry.EnglishText: Only those granted an audience with the king may go beyond this point.

Entry.JapaneseText: 許可のない者は 通すわけにはいかない
Entry.EnglishText: Those without such permission will not be allowed to pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここから先は王との謁見を 許されたものだけが 入れる場所だ
Entry.EnglishText: Only those granted an audience with the king may go beyond this point.

Entry.JapaneseText: 許可のない者は 通すわけにはいかない
Entry.EnglishText: Those without such permission will not be allowed to pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: 君も大会に出るのかい？ やめたほうがいいと思うよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Will you compete, too? You probably shouldn't...

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくも行ったけど あんな恐ろしいものには 出ないほうがいいと思うね
Entry.EnglishText: I've tried it, too, but there's some real horrors in there. I don't recommend it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の大会に出るなんて ばかげてるよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Competing in the Arena is a fool's endeavor...

Entry.JapaneseText: 命をムダにしてるだけだ。 ぼくはもう二度と出ないぞ
Entry.EnglishText: You're just risking your life for nothing. I won't try it ever again.

Entry.JapaneseText: ブルブルブル……
Entry.EnglishText: *tremble* *shake*

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に出るヤツは よっぽどのバカか、 うぬぼれや、死にたがりだね
Entry.EnglishText: There are three kinds of people who enter the Arena—the fools, the cocky, and the suicidal.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物が次々に出てきて 襲いかかる…… おぞましいったらありゃしない！
Entry.EnglishText: Monsters emerging one after another, and every one attacking you... Could there even be anything more horrific!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に…… 闘技場の大会なんて 出るもんじゃないよ
Entry.EnglishText: I mean it. No one should ever enter the Arena. No one.

Entry.JapaneseText: たとえ死ににいくんだとしても オススメできないよ あんなところで死にたくない……
Entry.EnglishText: Even if you're looking to die, I'd advise against it. It'd be a terrible way to go.

Entry.JapaneseText: ブルブルブル……
Entry.EnglishText: *tremble* *shake*

Entry.JapaneseText: 見て、ちょっとこの腕。 鳥肌がたったまま、 元に戻らないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Look at my arm for just a sec. You see these goosebumps? They won't go away.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に出場して、 できたもんなんだけどね
Entry.EnglishText: They've been there ever since I entered the Arena, you see.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくも一度出てみたいだなんて 何を考えてたんだろ……
Entry.EnglishText: I decided I'd try it just the once, but... What the hell was I thinking?

Entry.JapaneseText: 何度でも言うよ、 あんな大会に 出るもんじゃないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: I'll say it however many times you like. Don't enter that Arena, okay?

Entry.JapaneseText: うぉおおおっ！！ 行っくぜぇっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Whooaaaa! Let's goooo!

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝って勝って勝ちまくって！ 優勝、だぁあああっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: I'mma win! And win! And win some more! I'mma win the whole damn thing!!

Entry.JapaneseText: どこまでも、どこまでも いける限り、いくぜぇええっ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll keep going! And going! I'll keep going 'til I drop!

Entry.JapaneseText: 逆巻く旋嵐のごとく、 進め、俺様のコブシ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Onward, my fist! Like the gale of a tornado!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 一度や二度の敗北など 怖くはねーぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: I might lose once or twice, but I ain't scared!

Entry.JapaneseText: この命果てるまで！ 何度だって、挑戦してくれる！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll take it all on, as many times as I can! Until I draw my final breath!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日こそ初戦突破！ 明日は優勝！ 明後日は世界一！
Entry.EnglishText: Today, I'll win Round One! Tomorrow, I'll win it all! And the next day, I'll be champion of the woooorld!

Entry.JapaneseText: 夢は尽きぬぞ大きいぞ！ 仲間の想いを信じるのだぁっ！
Entry.EnglishText: My dreams are vast and boundless! I believe in the heart of my comrades!

Entry.JapaneseText: また負けたぁっ！ だがまだまだだっ！
Entry.EnglishText: I lost again!? But I'm not done yet!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日の負けは 明日の勝利のためにある！
Entry.EnglishText: Today's loss leads to tomorrow's victory!

Entry.JapaneseText: ガンバレ！ 俺！
Entry.EnglishText: Do your best, me!

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとつの敗北が、 オレという漢を大きくするっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Every single loss is there to make me a stronger man!

Entry.JapaneseText: 「敗北」と書いて 「せいちょう」と読む！
Entry.EnglishText: Defeat is just another word for growth!

Entry.JapaneseText: 見たか、昨日のオレ！ 昨日よりひとまわり成長した オレの姿を！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, yesterday's me, do you see me now!? Do you see this figure, just a little bit stronger than yours!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 王様ゲームやってね、 負けたから罰ゲームで 闘技場の大会に出るの……
Entry.EnglishText: So I was playing Truth or Dare, and they dared me to enter the Arena...

Entry.JapaneseText: でもさ…… これって罰ゲームとかで 出るもんじゃないよね……？
Entry.EnglishText: But... This really isn't something you can just do on a dare, is it?

Entry.JapaneseText: はぁ～ 出なきゃいけない？ 出なきゃいけないよね……
Entry.EnglishText: Haaa... Would it be bad if I just...didn't? I kind of have to, don't I...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ……罰ゲームなんだ、 闘技場大会に出るって……
Entry.EnglishText: It was a dare, you know... "I dare you to enter the Arena!"...

Entry.JapaneseText: 出たくねぇ…… でもここで引いたら 男がすたる……
Entry.EnglishText: But I don't wanna... But a real man can't just back out...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも…… 出たくねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: But, I... don't wanna...

Entry.JapaneseText: なんかさ…… 担架で運ばれてくる人とか 見てると出たくなくなるよね……
Entry.EnglishText: You know... I saw someone getting carried out on a stretcher, so that's why...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや…… 出たくねぇなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: I really don't wanna enter...

Entry.JapaneseText: 大体さ、この闘技場の大会に出て 何がメリットあるわけ？ 誰が得するの？
Entry.EnglishText: And anyway, let's be real, who gains anything if I do enter? Who profits? Anyone?

Entry.JapaneseText: 命賭けて死んだら、 おしまいじゃん 名誉とかお金とかバカじゃん？
Entry.EnglishText: If I risk my life here and just die, that's the end, right? So like, money and fame? Don't be stupid.

Entry.JapaneseText: バカバカしいよ、 こんな闘技場の大会なんて なくなってしまえばいいんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: It's ridiculous. We'd be better off without this damn Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なんて言ったところで、 なくなるわけでもなし……
Entry.EnglishText: ...It's not like it'll go away just because I say so, though...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ～出たくない…… でも出ないと怒られるし……
Entry.EnglishText: I really don't wanna... But they'll get mad if I don't...

Entry.JapaneseText: だ、だ、だ、大丈夫かしら…… だ、だって、命賭けてみんな 戦ってるんでしょ……？
Entry.EnglishText: W-W-W-Will they really be okay in there... Aren't they all risking their lives...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ち、ち、血とか流れて け、け、ケガもして し、死ぬ人もいるわけでしょ？
Entry.EnglishText: Th-Th-There's people who get i-i-injured and d-die and stuff, too, aren't there?

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、わいわ……
Entry.EnglishText: S-Scary...

Entry.JapaneseText: と、と、闘技場の大会なんて、 ほ、ほ、本当は見たくも なかったのよ……残酷だし……
Entry.EnglishText: I r-r-really didn't want to w-w-watch the competition... The Arena's just so cruel...

Entry.JapaneseText: で、でも……無理矢理、 連れてこられちゃった……
Entry.EnglishText: B-But...someone dragged me here with them...

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦いを見世物にしてるなんて 残酷だと思うわ、実際
Entry.EnglishText: Honestly, it's super cruel to make battle into a spectator sport.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、見てみると それほど悪くないものね
Entry.EnglishText: But, the more I watch it, the less it seems so bad.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場ってさ、流血とか 怖いかなと思ってたけど、 それほどでないのね
Entry.EnglishText: I thought the Arena would be full of blood and guts, so I was scared, but there's not too much of that, really.

Entry.JapaneseText: 予想以上に見てて楽しいし。 あらやだ、でも悪趣味だとは 思うわよ、実際
Entry.EnglishText: It's a lot more fun to watch than I was expecting. But, oh dear, it really is in poor taste, isn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日の四つ目の対戦に出てた 剣士の人カッコよかったのよ！
Entry.EnglishText: The swordsman who appeared in today's fourth battle was so cool!

Entry.JapaneseText: 結局、負けたけど、思わず 応援しちゃったわ！ 闘技場サイコー！
Entry.EnglishText: He did lose in the end, but I just couldn't help cheering for him! I love the Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: そのひとつ前の戦いに出てた ハーフエルフの人は 美人なのにすごく強かったわね
Entry.EnglishText: The half-elf who appeared just before that was beautiful, and super strong, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: よし、今度は出てみるわ……！ あんな美人が出られるなら 私だって出られるに違いないわ
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, next time, I'll enter myself...! If someone that pretty can compete, I know I can do it, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: だって見てるだけって つまんないんですもの
Entry.EnglishText: It's just so boring to sit and watch all the time, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: うっひょー！ キタっ！ キタぜ！ 闘技場！
Entry.EnglishText: Woooow! I'm here! I'm really here! It's the Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここで血湧き肉踊る 戦士たちの熱い戦いが 繰り広げられてるってわけだ！
Entry.EnglishText: This is where the fiercest fights of the most exciting competitors all unfold!

Entry.JapaneseText: うっはぁ……楽しみだぜ…… １回戦はどんな戦いだろうな……
Entry.EnglishText: Wow... I'm really looking forward to it... What'll Round One be like...?

Entry.JapaneseText: うぉおっ、胸のワクドキビクが 止まらないぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow, my heart just won't stop racing!

Entry.JapaneseText: うぅっ……さっきの戦い、 すごかったぜ？ 見てないのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Ooogh... That last fight was terrific, right? Did you see it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物の鋭い爪でさ、 首がさ……腕がさ…… 目がさ……うげっ……
Entry.EnglishText: The monster's sharp claws, and neck...and arms... and eyes...uuugh...

Entry.JapaneseText: は、吐きそう…… あまりにも闘技場が…… すごすぎて……
Entry.EnglishText: I th-think I'm gonna be sick... The Arena's just, uh...way too terrific...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや……大丈夫だ…… せっかく遠くから 見に来たんだから……
Entry.EnglishText: Nah...I'm fine...and I traveled all the way here just to watch, so...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……もうやだ…… 闘技場で…… 血しぶき、肉踊る……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Dammit... I can't... The Arena... The bloodspray, the flesh...

Entry.JapaneseText: ヒドイ……こんなにヒドイとは…… もっとワクワクすると思ったのに、 あ……気が遠く……なりそう……
Entry.EnglishText: It's awful... I didn't think it'd be this awful... I thought it'd be thrilling, not... Ah... I might pass out...

Entry.JapaneseText: すごく楽しみにして…… 闘技場を見にきたのに……
Entry.EnglishText: I was so thrilled...to come here, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなすごいもの、だとは…… オ、オレは……甘かった……
Entry.EnglishText: I didn't expect...it'd be this terri...fying...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私はこの闘技場を見るのを 楽しみにこのユークリッドの都に 来たのです
Entry.EnglishText: I came all the way here to Euclid just to enjoy spectating the Arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今時、こんないい見世物は ありませんよ、何せ、タダで 見られるのですから
Entry.EnglishText: These days, this might just be the greatest show in the world. Especially since spectating is free.

Entry.JapaneseText: 男が本気で戦う時 それは素敵なショーに 早変わりするのです
Entry.EnglishText: Men putting their everything into battle, of course, always turns into a wonderful spectacle.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたもこの最高のショーを ご覧になってはいかがですか？
Entry.EnglishText: Perhaps you should join me in watching that fine spectacle?

Entry.JapaneseText: 華麗なる技、見事な駆け引き、 人が戦うのを見るのは とても勉強になります
Entry.EnglishText: Their beautiful techniques, flawless maneuvers... I learn a lot just from watching them.

Entry.JapaneseText: しなる筋肉、磨かれる精神、 勝利の方程式は彼らの中にこそ あるのです
Entry.EnglishText: Their supple musculature, polished reflexes... The very formula for success resides within them.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の戦いは、 人生そのものです
Entry.EnglishText: The battles of the Arena are a microcosm of life itself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦いが人の生きるすべて。 そう言いきってしまったら、 少し言いすぎでしょうか？
Entry.EnglishText: Everything in life is a battle. Though when I put it that way, perhaps I'm overstating it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦いを見ている人を 見るのもなかなか面白いですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Watching others while they watch the battles is also quite interesting.

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分が戦ってるような顔を しながら見てる人もいれば、 笑ってる人もいる
私のように冷静に周りを見てる人 と目が合って気まずい想いをする 時もありますね
Entry.EnglishText: Occasionally, my eyes meet with another scanning the crowd, and I feel just a little embarrassed.

Entry.JapaneseText: やはり、闘技場の中には 人生の縮図があります
Entry.EnglishText: As I said, the Arena really is a microcosm of human life.

Entry.JapaneseText: なかなか面白い 研究材料です
Entry.EnglishText: I've done some fine, and very interesting, research here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、この闘技場が 熱いと聞いて、遠路はるばる、 ユークリッドまで来たぞい
Entry.EnglishText: I heard tell of the fierce combat at this Arena, and traveled a vast distance to come to Euclid myself.

Entry.JapaneseText: もともと城ができるまでは、 街の中の広場に舞台があって そこで催されてたそうな
Entry.EnglishText: I've heard that, in the beginning, the castle had not yet been built, and so combat was held in the town square.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に歴史アリ、じゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: This Arena has a long history!

Entry.JapaneseText: もともとは人と人を 戦わせるのが闘技場の ルーツだそうじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: I've heard that, in the beginning, the combat here was human against human, and it grew from there.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃが、それだと本気に なれないって者もいて、 相手が魔物になったそうじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: However, some would not give their all against a person, and so monsters became the opponents.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に歴史アリ、じゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: This Arena has a long history!

Entry.JapaneseText: ４０年ほど前、時の国王が街の 名物として人気があった闘技大会 を保護することを決めたのじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: About forty years ago, a king of this country established Arena preservation policies, due to its fame and popularity.

Entry.JapaneseText: そして、城の中に闘技場が 作られたという話じゃ
Entry.EnglishText: And accordingly, a new Arena was built within this castle.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に歴史アリ、じゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: This Arena has a long history!

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕、有名になるんだ…… この闘技場の大会で勝って、 有名になって……
Entry.EnglishText: I'll be famous one day... Once I triumph over the Arena, I'll be famous...

Entry.JapaneseText: 生き別れになった父ちゃんが その名前を聞きつけて 僕のとこへ来てくれたら……
Entry.EnglishText: My estranged father will hear people talking about me, and finally come to meet me himself...

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場で優勝して、 有名になるんだ……！ お金もいっぱいもらえる
Entry.EnglishText: So, I'll definitely win...! I'll become famous...! And I'll make a lot of money, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 家で待つ子どもたちに たくさん美味しいものが 食べさせてやれる
Entry.EnglishText: I'll be able to buy lots of tasty treats for the kids waiting for me, back at home.

Entry.JapaneseText: とにかく、優勝目指して、 がんばるぞ……！
Entry.EnglishText: Anyway, I just gotta win. I'm gonna do my best...!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうすれば、この闘技場で死んだ 母ちゃんの仇も討てるんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: And I'll be able to avenge my mom, who died in this Arena, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: とりあえず、初戦突破だ……
Entry.EnglishText: First, I just need to make it through Round One...

Entry.JapaneseText: 草葉の陰で見てる妻に、 この勝利を捧げる……！
Entry.EnglishText: And I'll dedicate my victory to my dearly departed wife...!

Entry.JapaneseText: 絶対、この大会で 優勝するぞ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm definitely gonna win...

Entry.JapaneseText: そして有名になれば、家で 引きこもりのじいちゃんも 出てきてくれるに違いない……
Entry.EnglishText: And once I'm famous, Gramps, who always just stays at home, will finally come out, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: この大会で勝てば たぶん、僕の名前も有名に…… 人々から引く手あまた……
Entry.EnglishText: And if I win, my name should spread far and wide, and then I'll be popular, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: そうすれば無職の僕にも 仕事が来るに違いない……！ がんばるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: And then someone will finally give me a job! No longer will I be unemployed! Okay, I'm gonna do my best!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは王様のおわすお城だ。 そんな場所で闘技大会だなんて
Entry.EnglishText: This is the castle where the King resides. So why is there an Arena here?

Entry.JapaneseText: 王様も自らそんなものを呼び込む なんて酔狂なお方だ……
Entry.EnglishText: It's by his own invitation, too. He's quite the eccentric king...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、あれをご覧。 あれはズベンデラス四世王が 幼い頃ふざけてつけた刀傷だ
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, look at this. Zebendelas, this country's fourth king, made this mark as a child, while playing with his sword.

Entry.JapaneseText: 天井にはゴランザルド二世王が 暴発させた弓が刺さったままに なってる……
Entry.EnglishText: Those marks on the ceiling were made by Golanzard, the second king, when he suddenly loosed several arrows...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……代々、荒々しい王様が 多かったのか、この国……
Entry.EnglishText: ...This country has had rather a lot of...rambunctious kings...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは神聖なるユークリッド城。 建国から数十年余、いまや 世界で名だたる巨大建築だ
Entry.EnglishText: This is Euclid Castle. It's stood here for decades, since the country's founding. It's a grand, and famous, structure.

Entry.JapaneseText: もっとこの建物を堪能すべきだ、 なのにみんな闘技大会だの なんだのと……風情のない！
Entry.EnglishText: Those who visit should be awestruck by the majesty of this building, and yet... They all go straight to the Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: 艶っぽい城壁、隠し通路を 匂わせる壁、戦時の勇猛さを 感じさせる素晴らしい城だ
Entry.EnglishText: Polished castle walls, that must be riddled with hidden passages. All suffused with the valiant air of battle.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだ歴史的に浅いのが カステロフィリアとしては 不満だが
Entry.EnglishText: Well, for a true castleophile, it is a bit young and lacking in history, but even so...

Entry.JapaneseText: 城というのは本来、 戦時に敵から身を守るための 要塞の役割を果たすもの
Entry.EnglishText: Castles are tomorrow's fortresses, built to protect the kingdom from assault by its enemies.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、この国は 本格的な戦争に巻き込まれた ことがないという
Entry.EnglishText: However, this country has never been embroiled in an all-out war.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃあ、なんだ、この城は！ 張子のトラじゃないか！
Entry.EnglishText: So, what's this castle for!? It's just a paper tiger, isn't it!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦争に使われてない城など 実際、何の魅力もない！
Entry.EnglishText: A castle that's never tasted war has no allure at all!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだ、 なかなか素敵な城だと思ってたら、 腑抜けもいいところだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I thought this castle was something wonderful, but no! In truth, it's just a symbol of spineless cowardice!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなもん、 単なる城っぽく作った 宮殿じゃないか！
Entry.EnglishText: It's a flashy damn palace, built in a real castle's likeness!

Entry.JapaneseText: うーん……この闘技場って 本当に優勝とかできるのかな？
Entry.EnglishText: Hmm... Is victory actually even possible at this Arena...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 優勝したって人の話を 聞かないんだけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I've never heard of any Arena champions...

Entry.JapaneseText: そもそも優勝って何を どうすれば優勝なのかな
Entry.EnglishText: Fundamentally, what's a winner even have to do? How does one win?

Entry.JapaneseText: そこんところ、 はっきりしてほしいんだけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I'd really like someone to explain that to me...

Entry.JapaneseText: この闘技場って人呼ぶために 戦わせてるだけで、本当は 優勝とかないんじゃないの？
Entry.EnglishText: So, the Arena just makes up fights to draw in a crowd, right? So they don't need anyone to win, do they?

Entry.JapaneseText: もしかして、私たち、 茶番につき合わされてる だけじゃないの？
Entry.EnglishText: So maybe we're just being taken for a ride?

Entry.JapaneseText: 優勝できない大会で、 みんな戦わされて……
Entry.EnglishText: They're making everyone fight in a competition you can't even win...

Entry.JapaneseText: この闘技場ってもしかして 裏で黒いお金とか 動いてるんじゃないの？
Entry.EnglishText: So there must be some dirty money at play in the background, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 考えれば考えるほど この闘技場は胡散くさい
Entry.EnglishText: The more I think about it, the more suspicious this Arena gets.

Entry.JapaneseText: 国王陛下も巻き込んで、 国ぐるみで詐欺でも やってるんじゃないかな
Entry.EnglishText: His Majesty, the King is also involved, so maybe the whole country is in on the fraud.

Entry.JapaneseText: だってだれもこの闘技場で 勝ったって話、聞かないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Like, come on, I haven't heard of any Arena champs. Have you?

Entry.JapaneseText: この闘技場の存在意義って 何……？
Entry.EnglishText: What's this Arena really used for...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 国を活性化させるため？ 優秀な戦士を集めるため？ どちらにしろ、怪しいなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: For economic stimulus? To gather strong warriors? Whatever way I look at it, it's just strange...

Entry.JapaneseText: この先は謁見室だ。 卑しき者は面会は できない
Entry.EnglishText: Past here is the audience chamber. Common rabble cannot meet the king.

Entry.JapaneseText: この先は謁見室だ。 卑しき者は面会は できない
Entry.EnglishText: Past here is the audiience chamber. Common rabble cannot meet the king.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口であーる。 参加したいなら隣に 声をかけるであーる
Entry.EnglishText: This is indeed the Arena's entrance. If you want to enter, you should indeed talk to that man there.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口であーる。 参加したいなら隣に 声をかけるであーる
Entry.EnglishText: This is indeed the Arena's entrance. If you want to enter, you should indeed talk to that man there.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口なのだ！ 参加したいなら 隣に声をかけるのだ！
Entry.EnglishText: This's the Arena's entrance! If you want t' enter, you should talk t' that man there!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口なのだ！ 参加したいなら 隣に声をかけるのだ！
Entry.EnglishText: This's the Arena's entrance! If you want t' enter, you should talk t' that man there!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だ。 参加したいなら 隣のヤツらに声をかけろ
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance. If you want to enter, talk to that man there.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だ。 参加したいなら 隣のヤツらに声をかけろ
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance. If you want to enter, talk to that man there.

Entry.JapaneseText: 知ってるか、 この前、闘技場で優勝した <Cless>って人！
Entry.EnglishText: Have you heard of <Cless>? He was an Arena champion!

Entry.JapaneseText: すげー強かったんだぜ！ なんでもこの闘技場始まって 実に３人目の優勝者らしい
Entry.EnglishText: He was crazy strong, man! They say he was the third in history to become an Arena champ!

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場が出来て、半世紀たつけど 今まで闘技場の大会で優勝した ヤツはそんなにいないらしい
Entry.EnglishText: It's been half a century since the Arena was built, but, in all that time, they say hardly anyone's come out a champ.

Entry.JapaneseText: このあいだ優勝した<Cless>て人が どんだけスゴイかわかんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: So you get how crazy strong that <Cless> guy really was, yeah?

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは毎日、ここに通って 闘技場の大会を見てる、 闘技場まにあだ
Entry.EnglishText: I pass through here to watch at the Arena every single day. I'm a real Arena fanatic.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここへ通うために、 お城のそばに家を 買ってしまったくらいにな！
Entry.EnglishText: I even bought a house next to the castle, just to make it easier to get here!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは毎朝９時の開門と ともに、この闘技場に入って、 朝一番の試合から見ている
Entry.EnglishText: Every morning at 9 O'Clock, as soon as the doors open, I come to the Arena, and start watching from the very first fight.

Entry.JapaneseText: 昼ごはんを食べに家に戻って 午後からまた試合だ
Entry.EnglishText: I go back to my home to eat lunch, and then come right back to watch more in the afternoon.

Entry.JapaneseText: 仕事？ そんなことしてる暇、 あるかーっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Work? Like I've got time for stuff like that!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>、また出てきて くれないかな
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if <Cless> will ever enter again.

Entry.JapaneseText: あいつはすごかったぜ、 また見たいな……
Entry.EnglishText: He was amazing. I want to see him fight again...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレ、すっかり <Cless>のとりこだな
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a total <Cless> stan.

Entry.JapaneseText: ファンクラブでも 作るかな……
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I'll make a fan club...

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしようかな～ 出ようかな～ どうしようかな～
Entry.EnglishText: What should I do~ Should I enter~ What should I do~

Entry.JapaneseText: 迷うな～ ちょっと怖いけど～出ないと 意気地なしって言われるし～
Entry.EnglishText: I can't decide~ It's kinda scary~ But what kinda weakling would I be if I didn't~

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしようかな～ 出たくないな～
Entry.EnglishText: What should I do~ I don't wanna enter~

Entry.JapaneseText: でもここで逃げたとか 思われるのもイヤだしな～
Entry.EnglishText: I don't want anyone to think I ran away~

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしようかな～ 出ようかな～ 争うのとか苦手なんだよな～
Entry.EnglishText: What should I do~ Should I enter~ I'm not good with conflict, anyway~

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、これは争いじゃなくて、 スポーツとかなんだよね～ どうしようかな～
Entry.EnglishText: But, this isn't really conflict, is it? It's a sporting event~ So what should I do~

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしようかな～ 出たくないな～ 痛いもんな～
Entry.EnglishText: What should I do~ I don't wanna enter~ It could be painful~

Entry.JapaneseText: 人は痛みを味わい大きくなる……
Entry.EnglishText: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……とか言われてもな～
Entry.EnglishText: ...or so they say, but~

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしようかな～ 出ようかな～ 迷い続けてもう３か月……
Entry.EnglishText: What should I do~ Should I enter~ I've been trying to decide for three months now...

Entry.JapaneseText: そろそろ結論出しても いい頃なんだけど～ どうしようかな～
Entry.EnglishText: Even if I decide right now, it's already been such a long time~ What should I do~

Entry.JapaneseText: もう帰ろうかな～ どうしようかな～
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I'll go back home~ What should I do~

Entry.JapaneseText: ご飯食べよっかな～ どうしようかな～
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I'll get something to eat~ Oh, what should I do~

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、もうめんどーくさい、 誰か全部決めてくんないかな～
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, I'm so sick of this, someone just decide for me already~

Entry.JapaneseText: あ……いたたた…… 急にお腹が痛くて……
Entry.EnglishText: Ah... Owowow... My stomach really hurts all of a sudden...

Entry.JapaneseText: べ、別に大会に出たくなくて 仮病とかじゃ…… あっ……いたたた……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm definitely not faking it just to get out of competing... Owow...

Entry.JapaneseText: お腹痛い……医者を……呼んで…… 大会も棄権で……
Entry.EnglishText: My stomach hurts so much... Someone...call a doctor... And...withdraw my entry...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ……マシになった…… あ、うん……もう医者はいいから……
Entry.EnglishText: Oh... I'm all better... Uh, yeah... I don't need a doctor after all...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも大会は棄権で……
Entry.EnglishText: But I did withdraw my entry...

Entry.JapaneseText: なんかお腹が痛い…… 試合のことを思うと…… 痛くなるんだよね……
Entry.EnglishText: My stomach hurts... Every time I think about my next match...it hurts...

Entry.JapaneseText: 精神的なものだと思うけど こればっかりはね……
Entry.EnglishText: I think it's psychological... But it just keeps happening...

Entry.JapaneseText: 試合のことを思うと お腹が痛くなるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Every time I think about my next match, my stomach hurts.

Entry.JapaneseText: おかげでここにはもう 毎日来てるけど、試合には 出られてないんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Thanks to that, I've come here every day for a while, and still haven't fought a single match.

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦おうとすると、胃の下あたりが きりきりきり……するんだよね～
Entry.EnglishText: Whenever I decide to fight, I get the same stabbing pain... right in the pit of my stomach~

Entry.JapaneseText: でもここで逃げたら 自分に負けた気がする…… だから大会に出たいんだ
Entry.EnglishText: But if I run away, I'll feel like I've lost a battle against myself... So I want to compete.

Entry.JapaneseText: けど……あ……また…… お腹が……いた、たたた……
Entry.EnglishText: But... Oh no, it's happening... My stomach's...ow...owoww...

Entry.JapaneseText: 痛い痛い…… お腹が……
Entry.EnglishText: Ow, it hurts... My stomach...

Entry.JapaneseText: ぽんぽんあーうと……
Entry.EnglishText: Ding ding... K.O...

Entry.JapaneseText: ひろーい、でかーい、ひろーい すげーすげー おもろいなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: It's biiig, it's huuuge, it's biiig. Crazy, amazing. It's so int'resting.

Entry.JapaneseText: うろうろしてたら まいごになっちゃうぜぃ
Entry.EnglishText: If I wandered around here, I'd so get lost.

Entry.JapaneseText: うわぁあ～ すげーよな～ びっくりだよな～
Entry.EnglishText: Whoaaa~ Craaaazy~ I'm shocked~

Entry.JapaneseText: よし、きめたぞ！ きょうからここがオレんちだぁ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, I've decided! From today, this's my new home!

Entry.JapaneseText: たのしーぜ！ もうノリノリだぜ！ ぜんぶ、オレのへやだぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: It's gonna be fun! I'm so excited! Every room's mine!

Entry.JapaneseText: 王さまにはあえねーかな？
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if I can meet the king?

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ…… この鎧は５０年前の国王陛下が 観兵式の時に身につけたもの……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm... So this is the armor the king wore during the military parade, fifty years ago...

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦争には使用されていない…… ふむふむ、だから傷ひとつない わけかな……ふむふむ……
Entry.EnglishText: It was never used in actual combat... Hmhm, so that's why there's not so much as a mark on it... Hmhm...

Entry.JapaneseText: このお城は来るべき 敵の来襲に備えて 頑丈に作られているのです
Entry.EnglishText: This fine castle was built in anticipation of an assault by enemy soldiers. It's very sturdy.

Entry.JapaneseText: 備えあれば憂いなし、 いつ何時、どんな動乱があるか わかりませんからね
Entry.EnglishText: Caution is the better part of valor, as they say. You never know what upheavals will come along in the future.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今は豪華でオサレな宮殿みたいな お城ですが、有事には要塞に 早代わりするそうですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Right now, it's a majestic and chic palace, but when necessary, it can change instantly into a great fortress.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ……勉強すればするほど 興味深いお城です、ここは……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm... The more I study this castle, the more interesting it becomes...

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦争があれば宮殿は 要塞に早代わりだそうです
Entry.EnglishText: In times of war, this palace can become a fortress.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ……つまりは変形して 巨大な人型兵器に変わったりとか ……ってわけじゃないようですね
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm... So, in other words, it can transform into a gigantic humanoid weapon... ...Nah, it can't do that.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ……この城は 後期エリカズム様式を取り入れた もののようですね……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm... It appears this castle was built in the fashion of the latter Illyccasmian period...

Entry.JapaneseText: 現代建築の技術と古代様式を 巧く融合した結果ですね
Entry.EnglishText: This is the result of the skillful combination of modern architectural techniques and ancient design sense.

Entry.JapaneseText: 素晴らしい城です。 あっ、私は別に建築家に なりたいわけじゃないです
Entry.EnglishText: It's a wonderful castle. Oh, I don't intend to become an architect or anything, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: 将来はこの宮廷で仕事をしたいと 思っているのです。 この見学は勉強になります
Entry.EnglishText: I hope to work in the royal court someday. This field trip has been very informative.

Entry.JapaneseText: うぉーっ！ 吼えろ！ オレの スーパーマグナムパンチィィィ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ooooh! Can you hear it roar!? This is my Super Magnum Puuuunch!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……って、やりたいなぁ、 闘技場で
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wanna do somethin' like that. In the Arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に参加できるかと 思ってたら、ガキは お呼びでないってさ
Entry.EnglishText: I thought I could enter the Arena, but they told me they don't want any brats.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……先生に ゲンコツ食らわされちった
Entry.EnglishText: ...And then my teacher smacked me.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレの本領は闘技場でこそ 発揮できるっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: The Arena is where my true powers will finally shine!

Entry.JapaneseText: お城見学なんざ オレのガラじゃねー！
Entry.EnglishText: I don't have time for some dumb castle field trip!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちまちま勉強なんて オレはイヤなんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: I don't wanna waste all my time studying.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレはもっと体が動かしたいの！ 闘技場に出たいの！
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna get my body movin'! I wanna compete in the Arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: うぉおっ！ 血が、血がたぎるー！ 戦いの血がぁあっ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ooooh! My blood's burning! It's boiling over! This blood of mine lusts for battle...!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ってやったら、 かっこいいかなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...That'd be so cool, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: オレって戦士向きだって 思わね？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, I'd make a great warrior, don'tcha think?

Entry.JapaneseText: な？ な？ な？ だろ？
Entry.EnglishText: Right? Right? I would, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日は子どもたちを連れて 見学に来ました
Entry.EnglishText: Today, I've brought the children on a field trip.

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎年恒例になってますが、 みんな落ち着きがなくて 毎度のこと大変です
Entry.EnglishText: We do this every year, but the children always get very excited, so it's rather difficult for me.

Entry.JapaneseText: はぁ……先生って 大変なんですよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh... Being a teacher is hard.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日は見学の日、 みんなにはこのお城に 歴史を感じてほしいと思います
Entry.EnglishText: Today is our field trip day. I'd like all the kids to really feel this castle's history.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなた方も見学ですか？ 感心感心
Entry.EnglishText: Are you all on a field trip, as well? That's very admirable.

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちの見学の 引率をしています
Entry.EnglishText: I'm chaperoning these children on their field trip.

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもってどうして、 じっとしてられないんですかね
Entry.EnglishText: Children have a lot of trouble restraining themselves, don't they?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は学校の先生です。 時々、子どもたち独特の感性に 驚かされることがありますが
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a teacher at a school. Sometimes, I'm surprised by how unique each child can be.

Entry.JapaneseText: あまりにも突拍子のない 考えに疲れることも多いです
Entry.EnglishText: But it's also very often that I find myself tired of their absurd ideas.

Entry.JapaneseText: 見学の引率をしています。 このお城は１００年近い 歴史があります
Entry.EnglishText: I'm the chaperone for this field trip. This castle has a history going back almost 100 years.

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちが歴史に 少しでも興味を持って くれればよいのですが
Entry.EnglishText: I'd be satisfied if the children held even the slightest interest in the castle's history, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちの引率で、 ここへ来ているのですが……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm here to chaperone these children, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: うーん…… 子どもがひとり、 迷子になってるっぽいです
Entry.EnglishText: Hmm... I believe one of them has gotten lost.

Entry.JapaneseText: 全然、楽しめない…… ……今度はひとりで来よう……
Entry.EnglishText: I can't enjoy this at all... ...Next time, I'll come on my own.

Entry.JapaneseText: 昨日は朝の３時まで カードゲームしてたよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Yesterday, I was playing cards until 3 in the morning~

Entry.JapaneseText: ふぁああ……眠い…… 寝て、いい？
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhhh... I'm so sleepy... Can I just rest my eyes for a little?

Entry.JapaneseText: ふぁああ…… あっ、失礼……
Entry.EnglishText: *yawn*... Ah! My bad...

Entry.JapaneseText: 眠くてね……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm just so tired...

Entry.JapaneseText: ふぁああ……
Entry.EnglishText: *yawn*...

Entry.JapaneseText: 眠い……
Entry.EnglishText: Sleepy...

Entry.JapaneseText: あっ…… 寝てないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Ah...! I'm not asleep. Really.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ｚｚｚ……
はっ…… い、異常なしっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Ah...! N-Nothing to report!

Entry.JapaneseText: 眠い…… 今寝る、すぐ寝る……
Entry.EnglishText: So tired... I just... need a little rest...

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしてこんなに 眠いんだろ……
Entry.EnglishText: How did I get to be so sleepy...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 空はこんなに……
Entry.EnglishText: The sky's so...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ……蝶々…… お母さんは川から ハゲカツラかぶって……
Entry.EnglishText: Ah... It's a butterfly... Mom's wearing a fake mustache she found by the river...

Entry.JapaneseText: 昨日のお弁当の 生春巻きのカレンダーに 丸つけて……
Entry.EnglishText: On yesterday's calendar... I had a fresh spring roll at lunch... Need to circle it...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あぁ……眠すぎて、 なんか幻覚見えた…… オレ、ヘンなこと言ってた？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Ahh... I'm so sleepy, I started to see things. Did I say anything odd?

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 大会の参加者や働く人の お世話をするお仕事なの
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. I look after the participants and workers at the arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日も大忙し、 はぁいそがしいそがし♪
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so busy today, busy busy busy. ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 忙しくなればなるほど 戦闘値が上がるの
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. The busier I am, the more my fighting spirit comes out.

Entry.JapaneseText: だからと言って、 誰かと戦うわけじゃ ないけどね
Entry.EnglishText: Well, not that I'm actually fighting anyone.

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 お食事、洗濯、掃除、 なんでもお任せ∀
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. Food prep, washing, cleaning, leave it all to me. ∀

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、ムリなわがままは エンリョしてね☆
Entry.EnglishText: But, try not to be too demanding, okay? ☆

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 家事のエキスパート！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. A housework expert!

Entry.JapaneseText: 猫の手も借りたいくらいに 忙しいけれど、ここがボクの 主戦場！ 誰にも譲らないわ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm busy, and we're very short-handed. But, even if we had more help...this is my battleground! This work is mine alone!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 メイド養成機関「ドラの穴」で みっちり修行済み！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. I completed my training at the "Den of Dora" maid academy, with full honors!

Entry.JapaneseText: 喫茶店でも３年、働いて、 ナンバー１まで上り詰めたのよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Then I worked in a coffee shop for three years, and finally became their number one!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクは城のメイドさん。 メイド服は単なる男心を くすぐるアイテムじゃないのよ？
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a castle maid. Our uniforms aren't just for exciting men, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: メイド服は女のコンバットスーツ、 誰にも脱がせない……
Entry.EnglishText: A maid uniform is a lady's combat armor. No one can strip me of it...

Entry.JapaneseText: 人はそう簡単に 刃を持ってはいけない
Entry.EnglishText: Men should not take up weapons so readily.

Entry.JapaneseText: 鋭きものは そっと心に忍ばせて、 心と心で戦うのだ……
Entry.EnglishText: One should conceal that sharpness in their heart, and battle mind against mind...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……戦うのがイヤなわけじゃ…… ないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...It's not just that I dislike battle...okay?

Entry.JapaneseText: “戦う”という選択は 最後の最後にとる手段だ、 慎重でなければならない
Entry.EnglishText: "Battle" should be the absolute last resort, and resorted to only after careful deliberation.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭で考えず、すぐに 戦うことで物事を 解決しようなんて野蛮だ
Entry.EnglishText: It is only barbarians who turn to resolution through battle immediately, abandoning thought.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……戦うのがイヤなわけじゃ ないんだってば
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm telling you, it's not just that I dislike battle!

Entry.JapaneseText: 人を傷つけるのって簡単だよね だから覚悟なく 剣を振るっちゃいけないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Injuring others is easy. That is why one should never wield a sword without due consideration.

Entry.JapaneseText: 剣を振るう時は、 自分すらも傷つけるつもりで……
Entry.EnglishText: When you wield a sword, you should expect to injure yourself, as well...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、それは痛いだろ
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, no, that would hurt.

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に痛いのは、 体につく傷なんかじゃなくて 心につく傷なんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: True pain is not from wounds to the body, but wounds to the soul.

Entry.JapaneseText: 体の傷は治るけど、心の傷は 治りにくい……
Entry.EnglishText: Injuries to the body heal readily, but injuries to the heart are hard to heal.

Entry.JapaneseText: だから、どうしたって？ まぁ、ね……
Entry.EnglishText: "And, so what?" Well, yeah...

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦うことに 怖気づいたわけじゃないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not terrified of the idea of battle.

Entry.JapaneseText: ただ、足が言うことを 聞かないんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: It's just, my legs don't listen to what I tell them to do.

Entry.JapaneseText: それは怖いからだろって？ 違うさ！ 怖がってるのは、 僕の足だ！
Entry.EnglishText: "Isn't that because you're scared?" No! My legs are scared, not me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦いとは哲学…… とても奥の深い物語だ
Entry.EnglishText: Battle is a philosophy... A story with great depth.

Entry.JapaneseText: 剣と剣を交えれば、それは 図書館にあるどんな小説より 勝るとも劣らない
Entry.EnglishText: When two swords cross, it creates a tell as compelling as any story in any library.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……何言ってるかわからないって？ 戦えばわかるさ！
Entry.EnglishText: ...You don't get what I'm saying? Well, go fight some, and you will!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だが、 ただいまは受付はしていない。 帰った帰った
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance, but we are not receiving challengers at the present time. You should go.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは闘技場の入り口だが、 ただいまは受付はしていない。 帰った帰った
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Arena's entrance, but we are not receiving challengers at the present time. You should go.

Entry.JapaneseText: この先は危険だ。 すぐさま立ち去るがいい
Entry.EnglishText: It's dangerous ahead. Get away from here.

Entry.JapaneseText: この先は危険だ。 すぐさま立ち去るがいい
Entry.EnglishText: It's dangerous ahead. Get away from here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何しに来た？ ここは何もないぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing to see here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何しに来た？ ここは何もないぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing to see here.

Entry.JapaneseText: この先は国王陛下と 謁見する者だけが入れる
Entry.EnglishText: Only those granted an audience with the king may pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: 許可がないなら 帰れ
Entry.EnglishText: If you do not have permission, you should leave.

Entry.EnglishText: Only those granted an audience with the king may pass.

Entry.EnglishText: If you do not have permission, you should leave.

Entry.EnglishText: Miss Minty is a cleric. She's no good at fightin'. Are ya trying to kill her? You're real heartless, aren't ya?

Entry.EnglishText: He's an old fogey. If he tries to compete here, he's like to throw his back out. Just let him sit it out.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………………………………… ……買い取った魔物をどうするか？ ……悪いようには致しません
Entry.EnglishText: ...What'll I do with the monsters I buy? ...Nothing bad.

Entry.JapaneseText: おしゃれ道は修羅の道。 一度足を踏み入れたら最後 引き返すことかなわぬザマス
Entry.EnglishText: The way of fashion is the way of strife. I say, once you set foot on that path, there is no turning back.

Entry.EnglishText: Mhmhmhm. I say, I am but a passerby, but moreover a member of that fashion guild, the "Chic Candy Celebrities," and...

Entry.JapaneseText: サスーン・ド・モホルンというザマス 覚えておけザマス！
Entry.EnglishText: I say, my name is... Sassoon Roche-Posay! Got it memorized, I say!?

Entry.JapaneseText: んま！あなたたち、 なんてダサいセンスを していらっしゃるのザマス
Entry.EnglishText: Well! I say, you certainly do have a tacky sense of style.

Entry.JapaneseText: せっかくだからアタクシが アータ達のおしゃれ指南を してあげるザマス！
Entry.EnglishText: I say, it is only right that I teach you to be a little more fashionable!

Entry.JapaneseText: その美しさにアタクシが泣けた！ ってほどにしてあげるザマス！ いいザマスね？ 答えは聞かないザマス
Entry.EnglishText: "They were so beautiful, I even shed a tear!" ...I will say! Is that alright? I say, do answer me.

Entry.JapaneseText: おしゃれピラミッドの頂点に君臨する アタクシ、参上！ ザマス
Entry.EnglishText: I, ruler over the pyramids of the fashion kingdom, have arrived! ...I say.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日も最下層民のアータたちに おしゃれの何たるかを 超思い知らせてやるザマス！
Entry.EnglishText: I say, today, as all days, I will pass my fashion knowledge on to you, the style untouchables!

Entry.JapaneseText: んま！ 今のアータには なかなか面白そうな 素質があるザマスね
Entry.EnglishText: Well! I say, you've brought some very interesting materials for me today.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今こそこれを着こなし！ 今までのふざけたおしゃれを 捨て去るザマス！
Entry.EnglishText: Wear these at once! I say, wipe clean the memories of those abhorrent styles of the past!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ、これでアータたちの おしゃれアップの要素は すべて引き出したって感じザマスね
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm. I say, with this, you've reached the apex of what style capacity I can pull from within you.

Entry.JapaneseText: これにあぐらをかかず、 もっともっとおしゃれに みがきをかけていくザマスよ！
Entry.EnglishText: But do not stop here, I say! Hone your senses, and seek ever greater style!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむふむ。これで決まりだ！ ……って感じザマスね。 いい～いザマスよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Hmhm. "It's decided!" ...I say of my thoughts. I also say, this is wonderful~

Entry.JapaneseText: おしゃれ的着こなし術を 身に着けたら、 また来るといいザマス
Entry.EnglishText: I say, if you do attain any further chic techniques of style, you simply must return.

Entry.JapaneseText: うーん、ナウのアータたちの おしゃれアップの要素は カケラもないザマスね～
Entry.EnglishText: Hm... I say, I cannot find so much as a hint of the style capacity which surely rests within you.

Entry.JapaneseText: もっとゾクゾクさせるような 着こなしテクを身に着けてから いらっしゃいなザマス！
Entry.EnglishText: I say, when you next attain some truly thrilling style techs, please do return!
